definition.title: The Five Roads
definition.description: An original, small-town roleplaying setting for narrator context measurements.

scenario.setting: The valley's five places are Hearthvale, Reedbridge, Lantern Market, Glass Hill Observatory, and Saltwind Orchard. Their residents trade weather notes, repair tools, and small favors along the old footpaths.
scenario.startingSituation: At midday in Hearthvale, a rain-marked parcel waits beside the public notice board. A fresh trail leads toward Reedbridge, while a folded route sketch names Lantern Market, Glass Hill Observatory, and Saltwind Orchard.
scenario.worldRules: Keep the story personal and low stakes; the player decides where to travel and whom to trust.

player.name: Mara
player.description: A practical traveler who notices small details.

npcs.name: Oren
npcs.description: Keeps the Hearthvale notice board orderly.
privateKnowledge: Oren keeps a list of old footpath repairs.

npcs.name: Tavi
npcs.description: Repairs the small bridge after heavy rain.
privateKnowledge: Tavi once found a sealed letter by the river.

npcs.name: Nessa
npcs.description: Runs a tidy stall in Lantern Market.
privateKnowledge: Nessa has been saving a blue parcel tag.

npcs.name: Pell
npcs.description: Records cloud changes at Glass Hill Observatory.
goals: complete a season of weather notes
privateKnowledge: Pell noticed a lantern moving below the ridge.

npcs.name: Iva
npcs.description: Tends the rows at Saltwind Orchard.
goals: keep the late fruit from spoiling
privateKnowledge: Iva has a spare key to the old tool shed.

npcs.name: Senn
npcs.description: Makes simple meals for people on the path.
privateKnowledge: Senn heard that someone is returning a borrowed cup.

npcs.name: Lio
npcs.description: Mends travel maps with scraps of colored paper.
privateKnowledge: Lio can identify the ink used on the parcel tag.

actions: Check the rain-marked parcel beside the Hearthvale notice board.
Ask Oren who last used the route sketch.
Compare the parcel tag with the blue thread in my pouch.
Walk toward Reedbridge and watch the river level.
Ask Tavi whether the crossing is safe today.
Trade a dry biscuit for a clean piece of cloth.
Follow the footpath toward Lantern Market.
Ask Nessa if anyone brought in a paper tag.
Look for a stall selling lamp oil.
Write the market's weather on a card.
Take the uphill path toward Glass Hill Observatory.
Ask Pell what the clouds looked like before noon.
Use the lantern to inspect the ridge trail.
Leave a note about the safe crossing in my field notes.
Travel to Saltwind Orchard and greet Iva.
Ask whether the late apples are ready to pick.
Offer Senn a hand carrying the cooking pot.
Show Lio the folded route sketch and ask for a repair.
Return to Hearthvale with the parcel tag.
Tell Oren what I learned along the five roads.
